predicate.label: secretary to principal
predicate.definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified secretary role serving principal Y.
includes: explicit secretary-to or possessive secretary title for a named person or institution
excludes: consultant, adviser, spokesperson or director alone
ordinary communication or employment without secretary title
inferring leadership or a specific cabinet portfolio from secretary alone
ambiguous: an omitted department or principal when the role cannot be resolved
predicate.notes: This specific secretary role is separate from general advice, speaking for a principal, and organizational leadership.

This specific secretary role is separate from general advice, speaking for a principal, and organizational leadership.

rationale: Two explicit secretary-to/possessive-secretary title paths are the clearest specific principal-service role; the single consultant row and unrelated sports paths do not broaden that title. Root and catalogue reviewer approved after full dictionary inspection.
